roster_note: Appliance bays, drill/hose tower, dormitory above.
civic_program: a run of tall vehicle bays opening directly to the street
a watch room with sight of the bays and the approach
a drill or hose tower attached to the rear
dormitory and mess rooms on the upper floor
a locker and drying room beside the bays
a rear yard with a hardstanding and a fuel point
circulation: crew reach the bays from the upper floor without crossing the watch room
vehicles leave forward onto the street without reversing
damage_constraints: the bays are empty and their doors are open; the tower stands
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the bays read as vehicle bays, not as a warehouse
